1: # Tasks — `2026-06-30-agent-platform-cluster-hermes-cocoindex`
2: 
3: ## Phase 0 — Pre-flight verification
4: 
5: - [ ] **0.1** — Run the `bunchloch-utilization.sh` (a new audit
6:   script; see 6.1 below) and confirm bunchloch is below 80%
7:   utilization (CPU + memory). If utilization exceeds 80%,
8:   abort and surface to user.
9: - [ ] **0.2** — Confirm `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` is set in `.env`
10:   (or in the Infisical `dev-baile/litellm/master_key` slot)
11:   and that the upstream `http://litellm:4000/health/liveliness`
12:   endpoint returns OK. Run a sample completion
13:   `curl -X POST http://litellm:4000/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $LITELLM_MASTER_KEY" -d '{"model":"minimax-m3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'`
14:   and confirm a 200.
15: - [ ] **0.3** — Confirm the operator's Pocket ID subject is
16:   known (we'll need it to populate Hermes's
17:   `users.allowlist`). The Pocket ID admin UI exposes the
18:   subject as `sub` in the user detail view.
19: - [ ] **0.4** — Confirm the upstream Hermes v0.17.0 release
20:   is tagged; record the semver + SHA256 digest. The release
21:   page is at https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/releases/tag/v0.17.0.
22: - [ ] **0.5** — Confirm the user's macOS Photos library is
23:   exportable. The one-shot operator step is:
24:   `osxphotos export /Users/REDACTED_USER/Pictures/Photos\ Library.photoslibrary --no-progress --use-photokit-info --directory leabharlann/photos/`
25:   (operator runs this on the MacBook once before Phase 6).
26:   Document the export size for capacity planning.
27: 
28: ## Phase 1 — Stack files (Hermes)
29: 
30: - [ ] **1.1** — `mkdir -p bonneagar/stacks/hermes/config`
31: - [ ] **1.2** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/compose.yaml`:
32:   - `name: hermes`
33:   - Single service `hermes` (image pinned to
34:     `ghcr.io/nousresearch/hermes-agent:0.17.0@sha256:<digest>`,
35:     `pull_policy: if_not_present`).
36:   - **`network_mode` is NOT `host`** (the upstream default is
37:     rewritten to the 6-file GOLD_STANDARD pattern). The
38:     gateway runs on the `cianchoghlaim` bridge network with
39:     explicit port publishes:
40:     - `127.0.0.1:9119:9119` (dashboard, exposed to Pangolin)
41:     - `127.0.0.1:8443:8443` (Telegram webhook, internal only)
42:     - `127.0.0.1:8090:8090` (WhatsApp Cloud webhook, internal only)
43:     - `127.0.0.1:8080:8080` (SMS webhook, internal only)
44:     - `127.0.0.1:8645:8645` (WeCom/BlueBubbles, internal only)
45:   - `restart: unless-stopped`
46:   - Healthcheck: `curl -fs http://localhost:9119/api/health || exit 1`
47:     (`interval: 30s, timeout: 10s, retries: 3, start_period: 30s`).
48:   - Environment block: `HERMES_STATE_DIR=/home/REDACTED_USER/.hermes`,
49:     `HERMES_CONFIG=/home/REDACTED_USER/.hermes/config/hermes.yaml`,
50:     `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://litellm:4000/v1`,
51:     `OPENAI_API_KEY` (injected by Locket from
52:     `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY`), `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=hermes-agent`,
53:     `HERMES_DASHBOARD_BIND=127.0.0.1:9119`.
54:   - Volumes: `hermes-state:/home/REDACTED_USER/.hermes`,
55:     `./config:/home/REDACTED_USER/.hermes/config:ro`.
56:   - `depends_on: locket: { condition: service_healthy }`
57:   - `volumes: [stack-secrets:/run/secrets/locket:ro]`,
58:     `env_file: [/run/secrets/locket/secrets.env]`
59:   - `networks: [cianchoghlaim]`
60:   - `deploy.resources.limits: { cpus: '2', memory: 2G }`
61:   - `security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]`, `cap_drop: [ALL]`.
62: - [ ] **1.3** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/sidecar.yaml`
63:   (canonical Locket shape — copy from openclaw/openchamber,
64:   adjust `container_name: hermes-locket`).
65: - [ ] **1.4** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/secrets.env`
66:   (10 `infisical://dev-baile/hermes/<key>` references):
67:   - `OPENAI_API_KEY` (LITELLM_MASTER_KEY — note the rename
68:     from `OPENAI_API_KEY` to `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` happens at
69:     the Infisical layer, not the env layer)
70:   - `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://litellm:4000/v1`
71:   - `HERMES_API_SERVER_KEY` (admin token, 32-char random hex)
72:   - `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY`, `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`,
73:     `LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=https://langfuse.cianfhoghlaim.ie`
74:   - `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`
75:     (channel credentials)
76:   - `HERMES_OPERATOR_POCKET_ID_SUBJECT` (the operator's
77:     Pocket ID subject, for the day-one allowlist)
78:   - `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` (Langfuse OTLP/HTTP)
79:   - Header comments documenting the `dev-baile` folder
80:     structure.
81: - [ ] **1.5** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/pangolin.yaml`:
82:   - `http.routers.hermes-dashboard` —
83:     `Host(\`hermes.cianfhoghlaim.ie\`)`, `service: hermes`,
84:     `entryPoints: [https]`, `tls.certResolver: letsencrypt`,
85:     `middlewares: [tinyauth, secure-headers]`.
86:   - `http.services.hermes.loadBalancer.servers[0].url: "http://hermes:9119"`.
87:   - No other routes (the webhook ports stay on `127.0.0.1`).
88: - [ ] **1.6** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/blueprint.yaml`
89:   (6-label shape, single entry for the dashboard route;
90:   mirror `openclaw/blueprint.yaml` template).
91: - [ ] **1.7** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/.env.example`:
92:   - Non-secret defaults: `HERMES_PORT=9119`, `HERMES_LOG_LEVEL=info`,
93:     `HERMES_DASHBOARD_BIND=127.0.0.1`, `HERMES_USERS_ALLOWLIST_OPERATOR=`,
94:     `PANGOLIN_DOMAIN=hermes.cianfhoghlaim.ie`.

96: ## Phase 2 — Runtime config + Hermes allowlist
97: 
98: - [ ] **2.1** — Write `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/config/hermes.yaml`
99:   per the proposal schema:
100:   - `provider: { name: litellm, base_url: http://litellm:4000/v1, model: minimax-m3, api_key_env: OPENAI_API_KEY }`
101:   - `fallback_chain: []` (LiteLLM handles fallback internally)
102:   - `users.allowlist:` — populated from day one with the
103:     operator's Pocket ID subject (read from
104:     `HERMES_OPERATOR_POCKET_ID_SUBJECT` env var at container
105:     start; the deploy procedure has a 1-shot pre-check that
106:     fails CI if the env var is empty)
107:   - `channels: { telegram: { enabled: true, token_env: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, allow_from: [] }, discord: { enabled: true, token_env: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, allow_from: [] }, webchat: { enabled: true, bind: 0.0.0.0:9119, allow_from: [] } }`
108:   - `mcp_servers:` — the canonical 10 KCG MCP servers +
109:     `hermes-mcp` (Hermes-as-MCP-server, issue #342 preview;
110:     bound to `0.0.0.0:9120`)
111:   - `langfuse: { enabled: true, public_key_env: LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, secret_key_env: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, base_url_env: LANGFUSE_BASE_URL, env: bunchloch, release: hermes-0.17.0, sample_rate: 1.0 }`
112:   - `otel: { service_name: hermes-agent, endpoint_env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, protocol: http/protobuf }`
113: - [ ] **2.2** — Add a `hermes/init-allowlist.sh` script at
114:   `bonneagar/stacks/hermes/init-allowlist.sh` that:
115:   - Reads `HERMES_OPERATOR_POCKET_ID_SUBJECT` from env
116:   - Calls `POST /api/users/allowlist` on the Hermes admin
117:     API with the subject
118:   - Logs the result to stdout (the deploy procedure
119:     greps for the success line)
120:   - The script is `chmod +x` and is run as a one-shot
121:     init container in the omnibus Komodo procedure.

124:

127:     `run_directory = "/etc/komodo/sruth/bonneagar/stacks/hermes"`,
128:     `file_paths = ["compose.yaml","sidecar.yaml","pangolin.yaml","blueprint.yaml"]`.
129:   - `tags = ["host:bunchloch","tier:control-plane","type:agent-runtime","domain:hermes.cianfhoghlaim.ie"]`
130:   - `environment` block: `LOCKET_MODE=watch`,
131:     `INFISICAL_CLIENT_ID`, `INFISICAL_SECRET_FILE`.

133:   (5 stages — mirror `deploy-openclaw-arm1-oci.toml` shape):
134:   - Stage 0: prereqs (locket volume build, Bunchloch

145:     (expect `{"allowed": true}`).
146: - [ ] **3.3** — Write `bonneagar/komodo/procedures/deploy-agent-platform-cluster-bunchloch.toml`
147:   (6 stages — the omnibus procedure with
148:   `--skip=<foundation|observability|memory|surfaces>` flags):
149:   - Stage 0: prereqs.
150:   - Stage 1: `foundation` — deploy `lakehouse`.
151:   - Stage 2: `observability` — deploy `litellm` + `langfuse`
152:     + `mlflow` + `logfire`.
153:   - Stage 3: `memory` — deploy `cognee` + `graphiti` +
154:     `lancedb`.
155:   - Stage 4: `surfaces` — deploy `openclaw` + `openchamber`
156:     + `hermes`.
157:   - Stage 5: health checks (curl `/api/health` on each of
158:     the 8 stacks + 1 paperless-ngx + 4 OCR stacks).
159:   - Stage 6: validate (the 4 stack-doctor gates).
160: - [ ] **3.4** — Write `bonneagar/komodo/procedures/cron-ccc-reindex-bunchloch.toml`:
161:   - Daily 03:00 UTC on `bunchloch`.
162:   - Runs `bun run ccc:index && mise run py:typecheck && mise run turbo typecheck`.
163:   - Posts the result to the `#kcg-indexing` Slack channel
164:     via the Langfuse webhook.
165: - [ ] **3.5** — Write `bonneagar/komodo/procedures/deploy-apple-photos-ingest-bunchloch.toml`

167:   - Stage 0: prereqs (the 8-stack cluster is up; the
168:     `leabharlann/photos/` directory exists from the

170:   - Stage 1: `dlt run apple_photos_source()` (populates
171:     the `apple_photos` DuckLake table from the export).
172:   - Stage 2: `mise run cocoindex:update apple_photos_metadata,

175:   - Stage 3: route 1 sample document scan + 1 sample

178:   - Stage 4: register the 5 new Dagster assets in the

183: ## Phase 4 — CocoIndex v1 Apps
184: 
185: - [ ] **4.1** — Write `cianfhoghlaim/cocoindex/agent_registry.py`:
186:   - `AgentRegistryIndex` v1 App, target `agent_registry`
